resources.string: On the computer, run: agentx app pair. Type the address and the code it shows, or paste the whole pairing link into the address field.
That address doesn\'t look right. It starts with https:// or is a name like my-computer.example.ts.net.
Type the 8-character code from agentx app pair.
Too many tries. Wait a few minutes, then run agentx app pair for a new code.
Could not reach the computer: %1$s. Is this phone on the same network (Tailscale on)?
This phone forgets the computer and stops watching places. To remove it on the computer too, run agentx app devices, then agentx app revoke.
Get a reminder when you arrive at or leave a saved place, even with the app closed. Save places in the phone app (Alerts tab), on the dashboard\'s Places page, or with agentx places add.
Location: not allowed. Place reminders need precise location.
Location with the app closed: allowed
Location with the app closed: not allowed. Choose \"Allow all the time\": reminders must work with the app closed.
Notifications: not allowed. Reminders arrive as notifications.
Off. No place is watched, and nothing about where you are leaves this phone.
On, but waiting for location permission.

AgentX uses your location in the background only to notice when you arrive at or leave a place you saved. Android does the watching. The computer only hears \"arrived at School\" or \"left School\", never where you are.\n\nOn the next screen, choose \"Allow all the time\".
Only the place\'s id, \"arrived\" or \"left\", and the time. Never coordinates or a location history. Turn the switch off to stop it at once.
This build\'s signing fingerprint. Put it in places.android.sha256CertFingerprints so the phone app opens without an address bar.
